meta.title: Fresh fish from Egypt: 12 main species for export
meta.description: Tilapia, sea bass, sea bream, mullet, carp and catfish from Egypt for importers and distributors. Weight grade, packing and price confirmed per order.

hero.title: 12 main fresh fish species from Egypt
hero.intro: Sold whole and fresh chilled, graded by weight per piece and packed on ice. We agree the weight grade, packing and price with you for each order.
hero.whatsapp_message: Hello AZAFCO International, we are looking at your fish list. Species, destination and quantity:

grid.title: Species we supply
grid.intro: Search by trade name, Egyptian market name or scientific name, in English or Arabic.
grid.more_species: These are our main, most-requested species; we supply other species on request.

descriptions.tilapia: Tilapia, also sold as Nile tilapia, is a freshwater fish.
descriptions.sea-bass: Sea bass, also sold as European sea bass or branzino, is a marine fish.
descriptions.mullet: Grey mullet, known in Egypt as bouri, is a brackish-water fish.
descriptions.grass-carp: Grass carp, known in Egypt as hashayesh, is a freshwater carp.
descriptions.common-carp: Common carp, known in Egypt as qishra, is the fully scaled form of carp and a freshwater fish.
descriptions.catfish: Catfish, also sold as African catfish or karmout, is a freshwater fish.
descriptions.meagre: Meagre, known in Egypt as lout, is a marine fish.
descriptions.thinlip-mullet: Thinlip mullet, known in Egypt as tobar, is a brackish-water mullet. It is a separate product from our grey mullet.
descriptions.bayad-catfish: Bayad catfish is a freshwater catfish native to the Nile.
descriptions.silver-carp: Silver carp is a freshwater carp.
descriptions.mirror-carp: Mirror carp is the mirror-scaled form of common carp, with only a few large scales. It is a freshwater fish.
descriptions.sea-bream: Sea bream, also sold as gilthead sea bream or dorade, is a marine fish.

note.title: Specifications are confirmed per order
note.text: Weight grade, product form, packing, net weight and availability are agreed in writing for each order. Prices are confirmed per order, based on species, specification, volume, destination and trade terms. We do not publish price lists or stock levels.

specify.title: What to include in your request
specify.intro: The clearer the request, the sooner the export team can confirm what we can supply.
specify.species_text: The species and the weight range per piece you need.
specify.form_text: Our fish are sold whole and fresh chilled. Ask the export team about any other form you need.
specify.packing_text: Box type, net weight per box and any label requirements.
specify.volume_text: Quantity per shipment and whether the order repeats.
specify.destination_text: Country and city of delivery, and the documents your market requires.

custom.title: Need another weight grade or packing?
custom.intro: Send us the specification you need. We review other weight grades or packing against our actual capability and the quantities available, and we confirm only what we can supply.

notes.thinlip-mullet: Thinlip mullet (tobar) is a separate product from our grey mullet (bouri). Tell us which one you need.
notes.mirror-carp: Mirror carp (mabrouka) and common carp (qishra) are two forms of the same species, sold as separate products. Tell us which one you need.
